description: Add data nodes to a Search Engine Service cluster. ⚠️ newDataNodeCount is HOW MANY TO ADD, not the resulting total — a cluster with 3 data nodes given newDataNodeCount=4 ends up with 7. ⚠️ Node count cannot be reduced afterwards: SES has no scale-down operation, so the only way back from adding too many is deleting the cluster.

newDataNodeCount.description: How many data nodes to ADD. This is a delta, not the resulting total

name: ncloud_ses_add_node
